title: Add host-error record, landing watcher, decision-state; backtest D87
summary: Implement decision-sets §8 step 4 minus the brief component: GhCli writes athena.host-error/1 (status_code, operation, closed message_class), a landing-time watcher with exact matching writes append-only athena.decision-state/1, and athena.default-expectations/1 is added. Transient 5xx calls are recorded and retried a bounded number of times; the 405 on merge puts D87 under review on first occurrence, and athena backtest reports it.

defaults_applied.how: All new code is Rust in existing crates.
Tests for the 405 record, the 500 retry then success, retry exhaustion, the watcher firing on first 405, no-fire on soft or unrelated errors, and the backtest report; clippy clean.
Follows the reviewed design in decision-sets.md; the doc status line is updated to mark step 4 built.
Brief component and set selection are left out to keep the change focused.
Retry and recording are done in the host client, not in the land command only.
Firing is enforced by code-evaluated exact matching and tests, not prose.
Behavior is checked by cargo test, including backtest run against a fixture.
Host-error records omit raw stderr; no personal data.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The brief component (hashing decision-state fold into the reading) is held back because the request says to hold it back if it needs step 3 set selection; step 3 is not built, so it is deferred.
athena.default-expectations/1 is still called for by design §2 and §6 step 1, so only its record type, writer and reader are added, with no migration of the 12 defaults.
Bounded retry applies to 5xx host statuses (and a status-less failure is not retried); the bound is a small constant (3 attempts) with no backoff sleep in tests, set via an injectable delay.
Transient means HTTP 500, 502, 503, 504; 405 and 422 on merge are hard falsifiers; other statuses are non-transient and reach the user.
Status is parsed from gh stderr text of the form 'HTTP NNN', pinned by a test; if absent, status_code is absent.
D87 gets its typed header with the hard host-error signal in code (the decision view in decisions.rs/backtest.rs), not by editing docs/decisions.md.
Record kinds are added to athena-data records.rs and a records directory, following existing conventions; schema docs in docs/records.md are updated.
A CHANGELOG.md entry is added per D89.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena-data defines athena.host-error/1 with status_code (optional integer), operation (closed list including merge, create-pr, read-repo), job, phase, at, and a closed message_class; the raw stderr text is not a stored field.

athena-data defines append-only athena.decision-state/1 (decision id, state, firing record ids, date) with a fold to current state, and athena.default-expectations/1 (default_id, assumptions, signals, defaults version, proposal).
The gh client extracts the HTTP status from a refused call, writes a host-error record, and retries a 5xx a bounded number of times before returning the error; non-5xx errors are not retried.

The land path invokes the watcher after a host error and at landing; the watcher loads D87's hard signal (operation merge, status 405 or 422, one job), validates values against the vocabulary, and does not evaluate records from a firing's own introspection.
No brief component and no set selection are added; BRIEF.md, defaults.toml, athena.toml and records/ are unchanged.
docs/design/decision-sets.md §8 step 4 and docs/records.md describe what was built and what was held back; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Run cargo test: a test where the fake gh returns HTTP 500 twice then success lands with 2 host-error records and no user-facing error; a test with persistent 500 stops after the bound and surfaces the error.
Run cargo test: a test where merge returns HTTP 405 writes one host-error record and one decision-state record putting D87 under review on the first occurrence; a 404 or a 500 does not.
Run cargo test: athena backtest over a temp records fixture containing the 405 host-error record reports D87 under review, with the record id cited; without the record it does not.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check: both clean.

out_of_scope: Brief component for decision-state and set selection (step 3)
Migrating defaults or typed headers for D01-D90
Editing docs/decisions.md, defaults.toml, athena.toml or BRIEF.md
Backtesting other signals (step 5 beyond D87 and the 405)
departures: Larger than the reference: touches the data crate, gh client with retry, a new watcher, landing wiring and the backtest, so cost and time are well above the median job and verification is less likely to pass first time.
